gitCommit.subject: fix(e2e): use auto-edit mode for TextV2 text content test
gitCommit.body:
fix(e2e): use auto-edit mode for TextV2 text content test

After creating a TextV2 object, the floating editor opens automatically.
Use this auto-edit mode directly instead of trying to re-enter editing
mode via double-click which doesn't work reliably with Konva canvas.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
